items.name: Metal Manhattan
items.depicts: A four-by-five grid of intersecting purple vertical and orange horizontal metal tracks with a bright square via at every crossing.

items.name: FinFET Cell
items.depicts: A top-down transistor layout showing a teal active region bisected by a vertical purple gate bar and flanked by two orange source-drain pads with white contacts.

items.name: Interlayer Via
items.depicts: A single perpendicular crossing of an orange horizontal metal line and a purple vertical metal line joined by a white square via.

items.name: Complementary Tub
items.depicts: A teal substrate border framing two side-by-side square regions, one purple and one orange, separated by a narrow gap.

items.name: N-Well Pocket
items.depicts: A solid purple rectangle centered inside a thicker teal rectangular border.

items.name: Contact Cut
items.depicts: A small orange square pad with a single white square contact window centered inside it.

items.name: Crosstalk Lanes
items.depicts: Three parallel horizontal routing stripes—purple, orange, and purple—separated by white dielectric gaps.

items.name: Stray Electron
items.depicts: A tiny orange hollow square with one-pixel side lugs centered inside a mostly empty canvas, scuttling or floating.

items.name: Vacancy Hole
items.depicts: A tiny three-by-three teal square trailed on the left by a single detached black pixel inside a mostly empty canvas.
